Design taste foryour coding agent.

A skill for Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents. Build websites, apps and decks from scratch, or improve the UI you have.

1. Install in your project 
npx skills add kundan0907/slopless
2. Ask your agent

Use slopless quick. Improve this UI.

How it works.

You say what to build or fix. Before it builds, slopless asks a few questions, each with options A to D and a recommended pick.

Reply with letters, your own words, or “you pick”. “slopless quick” skips the questions. Then it builds, checks the result and reports every change.

Drag the glass.

Outside the glass is a default AI-made page. Through it is the same page after slopless. Move the mouse over it, drag on a touch screen, or focus it and use the arrow keys.

Before slopless. After slopless.

Four jobs for the same product, each built twice with the same words and data. Drag a handle, or focus it and use the arrow keys.

Pick a mode.

Name the mode in your request. If you don't, slopless chooses: Quick for existing work, Standard for new work.

Quick

Default for existing work

You have a page, screen or deck to improve.

A focused V2 with no interview. Up to three high-impact fixes, your content and working controls kept, and a check before and after.

Use slopless quick. Improve this page. Keep my content.

Standard

Default for new work

You are building something new, or redesigning.

Asks a few questions with options A to D and a recommended pick. Then it builds, checks and reports.

Use slopless. Build a website for my product. Interview me first.

Deep

The story is complex, the work is cinematic or 3D, or you want a detailed audit.

Standard, plus deeper exploration of direction, storytelling and motion.

Use slopless deep. A cinematic launch page for our new app.

Review

You want a critique, not changes.

Inspects the rendered result and reports findings. It never edits your files. Ask for one lens:

  • BolderMore scale contrast, one clear idea.
  • QuieterFewer competing effects.
  • DistillSimpler grouping and order.
  • HardenEmpty states, long text, keyboard.

Use slopless to review this screen. Why does it look AI-made?

Agents, if you opt in

For big jobs, add 1 to 4 helpers such as a builder, a motion specialist and a reviewer. It costs more, so it only pays off on large work.

Use slopless in agents mode with two helpers. Rebuild the deck.

Short on time?

Say “you pick” and slopless accepts every recommended answer in the interview.

What it fixes.

The usual giveaways of an AI-made interface, and what takes their place.

  • Violet gradient wallpaperOne palette chosen for your subject
  • Emoji standing in for iconsReal icons from one set
  • Tiny uppercase label above the headlineA headline that says it
  • Stock words like unlock and seamlessPlain, specific copy
  • A glow on everythingDepth only where it helps
  • The same default font everywhereA typeface chosen for the project

Real icons, fonts and assets.

Icons are real SVGs from five packs: Lucide, Phosphor, Tabler, Heroicons and Remix, fetched through Iconify and kept to one style. Fonts and photos come the same way, with their licences.

Fetch an icon
node slopless/scripts/assets.mjs icon lucide:ticket
See the packs, fonts and licences →

One family (Lucide, ISC licence), one stroke weight, fetched with assets.mjs and inlined.

A look chosen for your project.

Pick a palette and this whole page switches to it, including the example at the top. If you have brand colours, slopless keeps them exact and works out the rest.

Install slopless.

Add the skill

Claude Code plugin: add the marketplace
/plugin marketplace add kundan0907/slopless
Then install
/plugin install slopless@slopless

Optional: open /plugin, then Marketplaces, then slopless, and turn on auto-update. New versions then arrive when a session starts.

Any agent that supports skills
npx skills add kundan0907/slopless

It asks which agent to install for. Needs Node.js 22.20 or newer.

Claude Code, by hand
git clone https://github.com/kundan0907/slopless
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
cp -r slopless/slopless ~/.claude/skills/
Codex and others, by hand
git clone https://github.com/kundan0907/slopless
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills
cp -r slopless/slopless ~/.agents/skills/

Updating

If you installed with npx skills
npx skills update slopless

Or start from your situation

Use slopless quick. This dashboard feels cluttered. Make the main task obvious.

Regroups the screen around the main task and keeps your data and controls.

Use slopless to turn these notes into a 10-minute talk deck.

Interviews you about the story and look, then builds a deck with presenter controls.

Use slopless to build a landing page for Fieldnote. Brand colours are #1B3A2F and #E8B04A, logo attached. Keep my copy.

Keeps your colours exact, works out the rest, and skips questions you already answered.

One path. Visible evidence.

Version 1.0.1 · Release notes and previous versions

Audit, approved direction, nine ordered passes, checklist, report. Every mode now follows these checkpoints; Quick keeps them compact and Review makes no edits.

Spacing → Color → Icons → Copy → Type → Layout → Details → Visuals → Motion. A screen with no confirmed defect stays unchanged. Each change needs a named rule, a measurement or a before-and-after.

Launch visuals start with a plan and a settled poster, then get frame-by-frame rehearsal. Authored UI animation stays under 300ms, spatial travel follows arcs, and input gets visible acknowledgment under 400ms. Missing visual evidence means recapture, with the unverified checks listed.

Read references/run-contract.md, references/reel-learnings.md and the motion contract in the repository. The source map separates supplied reel observations from verified repositories.

unslop was created by Damir Sokolovsky (@heydamir), CC BY 4.0. Its nine-pass method is adapted here alongside motion and review mechanisms from unslop-skills and launch-visual planning from Benji Taylor’s Stageshow. No universal taste or conversion guarantee is claimed.
